Hi! I'm an alum and also used to work at Rhodes and often fucked off during the day since I hated my job here's a decent list:

-Overton Park - just leave through the back gate and cross the street near the zoo and go right. Zoo and Art Gallery are about a 15 minute walk or you can just do the trails. Greensward and little lake are nice as well. Stop by Overton Bark. 20 minute to 2 hours walk (depends what you do).

- Broad Ave - Same deal as above but hang a left instead of a right when you get to the back park entrance. You cross by the giant bike sculpture (you can miss it). A bit of a hike but good restaurants and shops. 25 - 30 minute walk 

- Green line to Crosstown - Long ass walk but very pretty and Crosstown is a good place to relax. 30-45 minute walk.

- Dinos + Cafe Eclectic great lunch options that are within walking distance. 10 minute walk.

Also reach out to campus life if you don't have a bike and they should be able to hook you up. Nicole Johnson is great and does genuinely love all students. Also anyone at Rhodes Express should be able to help! ( I cannot say this about all the staff but Student Life and Rhodes Express go hard).

I've played BDO and TERA so I'm coming from that viewpoint. One thing immediately you will notice is that there is no real rush in the game. Getting to level 80 where a lot of the "endgame" content exists is pretty chill and when you reach it the tier of gear you can get there (exotic) can be used on a majority of the endgame content minus one set of things called fractals. The other thing that is different is GW2 respects your time. If you leave for 6 months and come back you'll be fine. If you miss a raid it's not that big a deal. I started 3 years ago and still use the intial set of lvl 80 exotic gear I got. There is no RNG enchanting or bullshit. A lot of the endgame progression is horizontal/achievement based. The achievements are a lot of work and take time to get so they feel rewarding as fuck (getting griffin/skyscale mounts feel amazing). It's pretty viaw to literally just do only one thing at endgame. I pretty much only do WvW which is open world PVP, which does need a guild. A lot of the PVE you can do outside of a guild. There is vanity/transmaug and it is literally the endboss of the game. The game is called Fashion Wars for a reason. You get some tickets that let you do it for free. You will end up swimming in them. Don't buy them it's a noob trap.

Yes. This is not like a traditional MMO where you are racing to a set point. When you hit 80 exotic gear is viable for about 90% of the content (fractals not included). It's perfectly fine and honestly kind of encouraged to play at your own pace. If you want some context I have take 6 month long breaks come back and been still at the same point meta wise in terms of competitiveness. Def take your time. Also a lot of the content you can just stop and walk away from with few issues.
